history_title: From the rough 90s to international tribunals
history_p1: We started in 1996, when legal practice in Russia resembled gladiatorial combat. Our first semi-basement office on Taganka survived defaults, corporate raids, and endless visits from inspecting authorities.
history_p2: We survived the 90s in Russia and learned to turn any letter of the law into an impenetrable shield. Today, PosazhuZaDorogo has branches in Moscow, Minsk, Dubai, and Hong Kong, and our methods have become the gold standard of uncompromising defense.

services_title: We Assist Citizens and Foreign Nationals With:

srv_fam_desc: Legal Definition: Comprehensive legal representation in high-value marital asset division, prenuptial agreement challenges, child custody, and international alimony enforcement.
srv_bus_desc: Legal Definition: Legal structuring of real estate, shareholdings, and securities through closed trust vehicles to shield assets from secondary corporate liability and hostile creditors.
srv_bankr_desc: Legal Definition: Judicial procedure for individual debt discharge under insolvency statutes, extinguishing unpayable credit claims while protecting primary residential estate.
srv_migr_desc: Legal Definition: Appealing undesirable alien declarations, entry bans, residence permit revocations, and foreign extradition notices across international courts and Interpol.
srv_tax_desc: Legal Definition: Challenging field tax audit assessments, unlocking frozen commercial bank accounts, and preventing bureaucratic abuses of authority.
srv_corp_arb_desc: Legal Definition: Representation in commercial and arbitration courts regarding breach of contract, supply disputes, and legal invalidation of fraudulent transactions.
srv_corp_tax_desc: Legal Definition: High-level risk auditing of corporate groups, structuring intercompany transactions, and defending against VAT and profit tax assessments.
srv_corp_raid_desc: Legal Definition: Preventing illicit executive removals, siphoning of assets, contesting board resolutions, and repelling corporate raiding attempts.
srv_corp_bankr_desc: Legal Definition: Shielding corporate officers, directors, and beneficial owners from secondary liability during enterprise insolvency proceedings.
srv_corp_intl_desc: Legal Definition: Dispute resolution at ICAC, LCIA, ICC, and cross-border enforcement of foreign arbitral awards globally.
